QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_21

question.text: Material changes in the PPM and fund documents of an AIF must be intimated to investors and SEBI on a consolidated basis:

answer.text: Within 1 month of the end of each financial year
Within 30 days of the change itself
Within 7 working days of the change
Immediately upon the change taking effect

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 28-related SEBI guidance requires intimation of PPM and fund-document changes to investors AND SEBI on a CONSOLIDATED basis within 1 month of the end of each financial year. The intimation must specify the changes with revised pages. The Trap: 7 days / 30 days / immediate-notice are fake distractors tied to different compliance regimes. The AIF Regulation uses a CONSOLIDATED annual cadence. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same 1-month-post-FYE consolidation. XIX-D also tests for Cat I/II. Manager's Pro-Tip: Even though the REGULATORY filing is consolidated annually, investor-relations best-practice is to flag material changes proactively in the quarterly letter. Don't spring a PPM fee-structure change on LPs in April for changes made in August — trust erodes fast.
